subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR land with the legacy no-code missing-source diagnostic invalidation path, or should old rows be handled only by doctor/manual repair?
rationale: The explicit marker path follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy branch intentionally changes runtime handling for old persisted SQLite rows that lack both `pluginId` and `code`.

options.title: Land targeted runtime recovery after rebase
options.body: Accept the explicit marker plus narrow legacy no-code missing-source heuristic, then rebase against current plugin registry changes and require the focused tests/checks to pass.

options.title: Drop legacy no-code runtime recovery
options.body: Keep only new `orphan-source-path` rows invalidated at runtime, leaving users with old no-code rows to repair state separately.

options.title: Move old-row cleanup to doctor
options.body: Handle legacy no-code diagnostics through `openclaw doctor --fix` instead of changing the startup fast-path heuristic.

recommendation.title: Land targeted runtime recovery after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit marker plus narrow legacy no-code missing-source heuristic, then rebase against current plugin registry changes and require the focused tests/checks to pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the explicit marker direction on the predecessor and merged adjacent current-main plugin load-path registry changes.
